Dear McQueen,
You're a real speed demon, aren't you?
I've calculated your chances of winning the next racing competition, and I've got the formula: P(Win) = (Your Speed x Your Skill) / (Your Competitors' Speed x Their Skill) + (Your Car's Coolness Factor) / 10.

So, buckle up, McQueen, because you're going to be the champion!
Good luck, and don't crash (too badly). P.P.S. If you do win, can I have your autograph on my math textbook?
